T: From a New York flat to the Colombian jungle.
D: A shy romance novelist heads to Colombia to rescue her sister and lands in a real adventure.
P: Serve the snacks when Joan finishes her novel with a glass of wine at home.
S: Griddled corn cakes split and stuffed with melting white cheese and butter. Mix 300g pre-cooked white cornmeal with 500ml warm water and salt into a soft dough.
Corn flour dough wrapped around spiced beef and potato, crimped, fried at 180C until crisp, with a green chilli and coriander sauce.
Mango, pineapple, papaya and passionfruit on ice with lime and a pinch of chilli salt.
M: the village where Juan's fans live
Chicken thighs simmered with corn, potato, cassava and plantain, onion, garlic and coriander for an hour until thick, served with rice and avocado.
dinner in the jungle after the mudslide
Whole snapper scored and rubbed with lime, garlic and chilli, grilled over hot coals for 8 minutes a side, with rice cooked in coconut milk.
W: the giant emerald everyone is chasing
Fresh lime juice and sugar syrup set with gelatine in a faceted mould for 4 hours, turned out and served with chilled coconut cream and mint.
K: coffee country in the Colombian highlands
Strong drip coffee sweetened with raw sugar, or poured over ice with cold milk for the jungle heat.

s.how: Mix 300g pre-cooked white cornmeal with 500ml warm water and salt into a soft dough. Shape 8 patties and cook on a buttered pan for 5 minutes a side. Split and stuff with 200g sliced mozzarella.

Fry 300g beef mince with a diced potato and 1 tsp cumin until cooked and cool. Mix 250g arepa flour with 350ml warm water and salt. Flatten balls of dough, fill, fold and crimp. Fry at 180C until crisp. Blitz coriander, a green chilli, lime and oil for sauce.

m.note: the village where Juan's fans live
m.how: Simmer 1kg chicken thighs in 2.5L water with an onion and 2 garlic cloves for 30 minutes. Add 3 corn cobs cut in chunks, 500g potatoes, 400g cassava and a green plantain and simmer an hour until thick. Finish with coriander. Serve with rice and avocado.

w.note: the giant emerald everyone is chasing
w.how: Soak 6 gelatine leaves. Heat 300ml water with 150g sugar, stir in the gelatine, then add 250ml fresh lime juice and a drop of green colouring if you like. Set in a mould for 4 hours. Turn out and serve with chilled coconut cream and mint.

d.note: coffee country in the Colombian highlands
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water so it's strong. Sweeten with raw sugar and pour into mugs, or cool it and pour over ice with cold milk for the jungle heat.
